fields.label: Location
fields.note: SuccessFactors free-text location box; the form also has optionsFacetsDD_location. RippleHire regional boards use geo=India, geo=Canada,United States, or the European country list.

fields.label: Country
fields.note: Country select on the SuccessFactors /search/ form; options are loaded by the board.

notes: The official careers page publishes five regional boards. SuccessFactors careers.ltm.com/search/ accepts q, locationsearch, optionsFacetsDD_country, optionsFacetsDD_location, sortColumn, sortDirection and startrow (the live form and result links use them). India/US/Canada/Europe use RippleHire: POST /candidate/candidatejobsearch with form field careerSiteUrlParams = JSON {token, source=CAREERSITE, search, geo, page, pagesize}; search=engineer reduced the India total from 649 to 199. keyword_param is q on SuccessFactors and search inside the RippleHire JSON body.
